It fulfills all acceptance criteria from the ticket, including updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, though the plain-object test in `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` stops short of explicitly asserting `error.cause === reason` (unlike its string and `undefined` unit tests). Compared to the reference, which adds the test directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and uses `JSON.stringify` fallback for the error message, the candidate splits tests across three new files (plus `.lore/dod.md`) and uses `String(error)` (which yields `'[object Object]'` for plain objects and skips the ESLint disable-comment description rule if enforced).
